unit_list.temple_candidates_note: RULE.md list: places.csv jer_temple 3,5,7,8,12,12a,13,14; jer_east_gate 9,10; plus 6,13,14 (ha-Melah = Millo). Union = 11 entries. Entries 4 and 11 (Kohlit) are inside 'entries 3-14' of the README row but are not in the rule's list; they are excluded (literal reading of RULE.md).
unit_list.control_note: Rule: '10 entries from the Jericho/desert block (entries 20-30)'. 20-30 is 11 entries; the primary control is the first ten (20-29); entry 30 is scored and reported separately (deviation).

scoring_rule_fixed_now.anchor_and_object: Each entry has an OBJECT (the hiding place: cistern, pit, cave, chamber, tomb, court-corner) and usually an ANCHOR (the named landmark: court of X, East Gate, wall, ha-Melah, house of X). A Middot feature is scored as the anchor if the entry has one, else as the object.
scoring_rule_fixed_now.type_agree: The Middot feature is of the same kind as the entry's anchor (or object) word: court ~ hatser/azarah; cistern ~ bor; chamber ~ lishkah/tsariah-like room; gate ~ shaar/pishpesh; wall ~ homah/kotel; stair ~ mesibbah/maalot; tomb ~ qever. If the anchor is NAMED (peristyle, Mattiyah/wood, MDH, Manos, Melah, the lost court name), type_agree additionally needs the Middot name to share the root/word, or an alias attested in a source; a different name with no attested alias = unknown (not fail).
scoring_rule_fixed_now.relation_values: Each positional relation of the entry is: AGREE (Middot/Tamid/Shekalim states the same relation for that feature), SILENT (the text gives nothing on it) or CONTRADICT (the text gives a position or structure that excludes it).
scoring_rule_fixed_now.strict_pass: type agrees AND every positional relation AGREEs.
scoring_rule_fixed_now.lenient_pass: type agrees AND no relation CONTRADICTs (SILENT allowed).
scoring_rule_fixed_now.fail: type incompatible (feature is of a kind the entry's anchor/object word cannot denote), or any relation CONTRADICTs.
scoring_rule_fixed_now.unknown: everything else (e.g. type agrees on kind but the anchor name has no attested correspondence; or the type cannot be judged because the entry's key word is unread/unresolved).
scoring_rule_fixed_now.joint_fit: An assignment of entries to Middot features, each entry passing (strict and lenient reported separately), with all inter-entry relations satisfied (same-anchor pairs on the same feature; stated directions between entries consistent with Middot's layout). Literal: features distinct. Deviation branch: entries whose text forces the same anchor (12/12a same court; 13/14 the same ha-Melah) may share that feature.
scoring_rule_fixed_now.decision: Supported if a joint fit exists for >=5 Temple entries with no fail AND control entries achieve clearly fewer passes (reported as counts; 'clearly' taken as at least 3 fewer passing entries out of 10, and a one-sided Fisher exact p reported).

R3.2 cache in the cistern's floor
